meaning: Join finite source-derived authored composition behavior controls into the shared public project verifier without replacing whole-project obligations.
definition_binding: Load the exact qualified binding, reference, cases, effect audit and controls definitions from the compiled source capsule. Pin each definition independently. No development-filesystem fallback or caller definition substitution is permitted.
coverage: Retain every selected composition and its entire case family. Only typed case-search, reference-capacity and case-value unavailability becomes not_evaluable; definition, source binding and provenance defects remain failures. Never interpret an unavailable search as unsatisfiability or drop its row to obtain a passing aggregate.
execution: Use the existing process-registered controls and private native executor. The public parent owns complete source replay, whole supporting-artifact coverage and source-disk currentness. Execute computation modules only, with the existing permission restrictions and independent expected answers. Do not start an endpoint, transport, database or production provider.
custody: Create each computation workspace strictly beneath the parent-owned temporary run root. Retain process-registered execution receipts and revalidate their exact file inventory, source binding and tool fingerprints after final source and target checks and before cleanup. A failure retains its phase and no passing prefix. Parent cleanup covers successful and failed child runs, with the existing parent directory identity check.
dependencies: A composition behavior pass depends on exact source replay, native compilation and surface observation, JavaScript syntax, source and selection preservation, selected Calculation bindings, full artifact and tool currentness, composition evidence currentness, successful owned workspace cleanup and existing-target currentness when a target was supplied. Late prerequisite failure invalidates an earlier passing observation. Missing optional target input does not prevent a bounded behavior check, but remains an explicit whole-report unmet obligation.
entrypoints: The direct executor, source project API, registered snapshot API, existing public verify overload and CLI use the same implementation in both supported output layouts. Keep composition case, binding, coverage, audit and observation identities in report evidence. Unsupported cross-generator behavior and concurrent output publication remain separately not_evaluable.
verification: Run actual public source, snapshot and CLI verification, both layouts, unchanged target checks and owned cleanup. Exercise unavailable source families, executed semantic mutations, effect rejection, stale observations, support-artifact drift, source drift and cleanup failure. Preserve all predecessor capsule rows and materialize additions only through the official generator.
claim_ceiling: Finite public composition computation evidence only, not universal proof, runtime provider conformance, whole CLI completion, approval, admission, installation, publication or release. Full R08-R18 scope remains active.
